description: Curated registry of Romanian parliamentarians, presidents, prime ministers, and ministers who appear as canonical speakers in Monitorul Oficial Partea II stenograms, committee syntheses, question registers, interpellation transcripts, and report receptions. Q4 of docs/elasticsearch-indexing.md. Seed entries are hand-curated against the highest-frequency clusters in data/speaker_clusters.jsonl (top ~80 by aggregate mention count); additional entries arrive via tools/scrape_cdep.py + tools/scrape_wikidata.py + manual long-tail resolution. Each `id` is a kebab-case `<surname>-<given_name>` slug stable across registry refreshes — downstream URL slugs (politicieni/<slug>) and ES `_id` on the mo-persons index key off this. Diacritic_form preserves the canonical Unicode form (modern comma diacritics: ț, ș); aliases include name-order variants (Surname First / First Surname), mojibake variants observed in the corpus (V„c„roiu / Vãcãroiu / Văcăroiu — all the same person), and common nickname / abbreviation forms. Mandates are best-effort; missing dates are null and the homonym-disambiguation tier in normalize_speaker treats null as 'don't know' rather than 'never'. wikidata_qid is null when not yet looked up — the QID enriches the Wikidata seed but is not load-bearing for matching.
